definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [PARTICULAR] used before nouns to refer to things or people when a listener or reader knows which particular things or people are being referred to, especially because they have already been mentioned or because what is happening makes it clear
2. used before some nouns that refer to place when you want to mention that type of place, without showing exactly which example of the place you mean
3. used before noun phrases in which the range of meaning of the noun is limited in some way
4. used to refer to things or people when only one exists at any one time
5. used before superlatives and other words, such as 'first' or 'only' or numbers showing something's position in a list, which refer to only one thing or person
examples: [{"en": "I just bought a new shirt and some new shoes. The shirt was quite expensive, but the shoes weren't.", "cn": "我刚买了一件新衬衫和一些新鞋子。这件衬衫很贵，但鞋子却不贵。"}, {"en": "Please would you pass the salt.", "cn": "请你把盐递过来。"}, {"en": "I'll pick you up at the station.", "cn": "我去车站接你。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [POSSESSION] used to show possession, belonging or origin
2. [AMOUNT] used after words or phrases expressing amount, number or a particular unit
3. [CONTAINING] containing
4. [POSITION] used in expressions showing position
5. [TYPICAL] typical or characteristic of
examples: [{"en": "a friend of mine", "cn": "我的一个朋友"}, {"en": "the president of the United States", "cn": "美国总统"}, {"en": "employees of the company", "cn": "公司员工"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [ALSO] used to join two words, phrases, parts of sentences or related statements together; also or in addition to
2. and so on ( also and so forth )
3. and all
4. and all that informal
5. and/or
examples: [{"en": "Ann and Jim", "cn": "安和吉姆"}, {"en": "boys and girls", "cn": "男孩和女孩"}, {"en": "knives and forks", "cn": "刀叉"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [INFINITIVE] used before a verb to show that it is in the infinitive
2. used after some verbs, especially when the action described in the infinitive will happen later
3. used after many verbs of agreeing, needing and wanting
4. used instead of repeating a verb clause
5. used in phrases where there are reported orders and requests
examples: [{"en": "She agreed to help.", "cn": "她同意帮忙。"}, {"en": "I'll have to tell him.", "cn": "我得告诉他。"}, {"en": "Sadly she didn't live to see her grandchildren.", "cn": "遗憾的是，她没能活着见到自己的孙子。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [INSIDE] inside or towards the inside of a container, place or area, or surrounded or closed off by something
2. into something
3. [PART] forming a part of something
4. [DURING] during part or all of a period of time
5. in between
examples: [{"en": "Put the milk back in the fridge when you've finished with it.", "cn": "喝完牛奶后，将其放回冰箱。"}, {"en": "Is Mark still in bed?", "cn": "马克还在床上吗？"}, {"en": "I got stuck in a traffic jam for half an hour.", "cn": "我堵车了半个小时。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [INTENDED FOR] intended to be given to
2. [PURPOSE] having the purpose of
3. [BECAUSE OF] because of or as a result of something
4. if it wasn't/weren't for ( also if it hadn't been for )
5. used to show an amount of time or distance
examples: [{"en": "There's a phone message for you.", "cn": "有一条电话留言给你。"}, {"en": "I'd better buy something for the new baby.", "cn": "我最好给新宝宝买点东西。"}, {"en": "There's a prize for the fastest three runners in each category.", "cn": "每个类别中跑得最快的三名选手都有一个奖项。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. he/she/it form of be
2. • The surname 'Smith' is very common in Britain
3. • This machine is easy to use
4. • Salt is a compound of sodium and chlorine
examples: [{"en": "The surname 'Smith' is very common in Britain.", "cn": "“史密斯”这个姓氏在英国很常见。"}, {"en": "This machine is easy to use.", "cn": "这台机器很容易使用。"}, {"en": "Salt is a compound of sodium and chlorine.", "cn": "盐是钠和氯的化合物。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [ABOVE] used to show that something is in a position above something else and touching it, or that something is moving into such a position
2. [CONNECTED] covering the surface of, being held by, or connected to
3. [TIME] used to show when something happens
4. [WRITING] used to show where something has been written, printed or drawn
5. [TRAVEL] used for showing some methods of travelling
examples: [{"en": "Look at all the books on your desk!", "cn": "看看你桌子上的书！"}, {"en": "Ow, you're standing on my foot!", "cn": "哎呀，你踩到我的脚了！"}, {"en": "Your suitcase is on top of the wardrobe.", "cn": "你的手提箱在衣柜顶上。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. used to refer to a person, object, idea, etc. which is separated from the speaker by space or time
2. used to refer to something which has been mentioned or was involved earlier, or to something with which the listener will be familiar
1. [USED TO REFER] used as the subject or object of a verb to show which person or thing you are referring to, or to add information about a person or thing just mentioned. It is used for both people and things. It can often be left out
2. [SOMETHING NOT HERE] used to make a connection with an earlier statement
3. used to express a reaction to something
examples: [{"en": "• This is Sarah, who will be working with us for a few months.", "cn": "• 这是莎拉，她将与我们一起工作几个月。"}, {"en": "• Do you like these earrings I'm wearing?", "cn": "• 你喜欢我戴的这些耳环吗？"}, {"en": "• That girl over there is called Sarah.", "cn": "• 那边那个女孩叫莎拉。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [CAUSE] used to show the person or thing that does something
2. [METHOD] used to show how something is done
3. [NOT LATER THAN] not later than; at or before
4. [MEASUREMENT] used to show measurements or amounts
5. [DURING] during
examples: [{"en": "The motorcycle was driven by a tiny bald man.", "cn": "驾驶摩托车的是一个身材矮小的光头男子。"}, {"en": "We were amazed by what she told us.", "cn": "她告诉我们的事情让我们感到惊讶。"}, {"en": "I'm reading some short stories (written) by Chekhov.", "cn": "我正在读契诃夫（写的）一些短篇小说。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. used for a person, object, idea, etc. to show which one is referred to\n2. by this time ( also before this )
examples: [{"en": "Can you sign this form here for me?", "cn": "您可以帮我在这儿签署这份表格吗？"}, {"en": "These books are too heavy for me to carry.", "cn": "这些书太重了，我搬不动。"}, {"en": "We met this girl", "cn": "我们遇见了这个女孩"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [COMPANY] in the company or presence of a person or thing
2. [METHOD] using something
3. [DESCRIPTION] having or including something
4. used at the beginning of various phrases written at the end of a letter
5. including
examples: [{"en": "I was with Sylvia at the time.", "cn": "当时我和西尔维娅在一起。"}, {"en": "He lives with his grandmother.", "cn": "他和他的祖母住在一起。"}, {"en": "He's impossible to work with.", "cn": "他是不可能一起工作的。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. used to refer to the person or people being spoken or written to\n2. [PEOPLE GENERALLY] people in general
examples: [{"en": "You look nice.", "cn": "你看起来很好。"}, {"en": "I love you.", "cn": "我爱你。"}, {"en": "You said I could go with you.", "cn": "你说过我可以和你一起去。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. (as subject or object) the thing, animal or situation which has already been mentioned
2. • "Where's my pen? It was on my desk a minute ago." "You left it by the phone."
3. • The company was losing money and it had to make people redundant
4. • The argument was upsetting for us all - I don't want to talk about it
examples: [{"en": "\"Where's my pen? It was on my desk a minute ago.\" \"You left it by the phone.\"", "cn": "“我的笔呢？一分钟前还在我的桌子上。” “你把它留在电话旁了。”"}, {"en": "The company was losing money and it had to make people redundant.", "cn": "该公司正在亏损，不得不裁员。"}, {"en": "The argument was upsetting for us all - I don't want to talk about it.", "cn": "这场争论让我们所有人都感到不安——我不想谈论它。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. used to form a negative phrase after verbs like 'be', 'can', 'have', 'will', 'must', etc. usually used in the short form 'n't' in speech
2. used to give the next word or group of words a negative meaning
3. used after verbs like 'be afraid', 'hope', 'suspect', etc. in short, negative replies
4. if not
5. or not
examples: [{"en": "He's not fat!", "cn": "他不胖！"}, {"en": "I won't tell her.", "cn": "我不会告诉她。"}, {"en": "I can't go.", "cn": "我不能去。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [POSSIBILITIES] used to connect different possibilities
2. used after a negative verb to mean not one thing and also not another
3. [IF NOT] if not
4. [EXPLAIN] used to show that a word or phrase means the same as, or explains or limits or corrects, another word or phrase
examples: [{"en": "Is it Tuesday or Wednesday today?", "cn": "今天是星期二还是星期三？"}, {"en": "You can pay now or when you come back to pick up the paint.", "cn": "您可以立即付款，也可以在回来取油漆时付款。"}, {"en": "Are you listening to me or not ?", "cn": "你到底有没有听我说话？"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [DESCRIPTION] L used to say something about a person, thing or state, to show a permanent or temporary quality, state, job, etc
2. intransitive usually + adverb or preposition used to show the position of a person or thing in space or time
3. L used to show what something is made of
4. [ALLOW] + to infinitive used to say that someone should or must do something
5. [FUTURE] + to infinitive formal used to show that something will happen in the future
examples: [{"en": "He is rich.", "cn": "他很有钱。"}, {"en": "It's cold today.", "cn": "今天很冷。"}, {"en": "I'm Andy.", "cn": "我是安迪。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. we/you/they form of be\n2. • Are you hungry?\n3. • They're (= They are) very late
examples: [{"en": "Are you hungry?", "cn": "你饿了吗？"}, {"en": "They're", "cn": "他们是"}, {"en": "very late.", "cn": "很晚了。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [PLACE] used to show the place where someone or something starts
2. [TIME] used to show the time when something starts or the time when it was made or first existed
3. from that day/time on(wards) literary
4. [DISTANCE] used to show the distance between two places
5. [ORIGIN] used to show the origin of something or someone
examples: [{"en": "What time does the flight from Amsterdam arrive?", "cn": "从 阿姆斯特丹 出发的航班几点抵达？"}, {"en": "The wind is coming from the north.", "cn": "风从北方吹来。"}, {"en": "She sent me a postcard from Majorca.", "cn": "她从马略卡岛寄给我一张明信片。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [PLACE] used to show an exact position or particular place
2. [TIME] used to show an exact or a particular time
3. [DIRECTION] towards; in the direction of
4. [CAUSE] used to show the cause of something, especially a feeling
5. [JUDGMENT] used to show the activity in which someone's ability is being judged
examples: [{"en": "We'll meet you at the entrance.", "cn": "我们将在入口处与您会面。"}, {"en": "That bit at the beginning of the film was brilliant.", "cn": "影片开头的那一段非常精彩。"}, {"en": "She's sitting at the table in the corner.", "cn": "她坐在角落里的桌子旁。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [BECAUSE] because
2. [WHILE] while; during the time that
3. [LIKE] in the same way
4. [ALTHOUGH] although
examples: [{"en": "She'll soon be as tall as her mother.", "cn": "她很快就会和她妈妈一样高了。"}, {"en": "I can't run as fast as you.", "cn": "我跑不了你那么快。"}, {"en": "skin as soft as a baby's", "cn": "皮肤如婴儿般柔软"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. belonging or relating to the person or group of people being spoken or written to\n2. [PEOPLE GENERALLY] belonging or relating to people generally\n3. informal said before a typical example of something is given
examples: [{"en": "Is this your bag?", "cn": "这是你的包吗？"}, {"en": "It's not your fault.", "cn": "这不是你的错。"}, {"en": "Your mother is driving me crazy.", "cn": "你妈妈快把我逼疯了。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. every one (of), or the complete amount or number (of), or the whole (of)
2. all in all
3. all the... you have
1. completely
2. used after a number to mean that both teams or players in a game have equal points
examples: [{"en": "All animals have to eat in order to live.", "cn": "所有动物都必须吃饭才能生存。"}, {"en": "She's got four children, all under the age of five.", "cn": "她有四个孩子，都还不到五岁。"}, {"en": "The cast all lined up on stage to take their bow.", "cn": "演员们全部在舞台上排队谢幕。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [POSSESS] transitive not continuous ( also 've/'s , mainly UK have got ) to own or possess
2. have the decency/good sense, etc. to do sth
3. [BE ILL] transitive ( mainly UK have got ) If you have a particular illness, you suffer from it
4. [DO] transitive to perform the action mentioned
5. transitive to eat or drink something
examples: [{"en": "I've heard that story before.", "cn": "我以前听过这个故事。"}, {"en": "Diane's already gone.", "cn": "黛安娜已经走了。"}, {"en": "John hasn't phoned.", "cn": "约翰还没有打电话。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [RECENTLY CREATED] recently created or having started to exist recently
2. [DIFFERENT] before noun different to one that existed earlier
3. [NOT FAMILIAR] after verb not yet familiar or experienced
4. [NOT USED] not previously used or owned
5. [RECENTLY DISCOVERED] recently discovered or made known
examples: [{"en": "a new car", "cn": "一辆新车"}, {"en": "She's very creative and always coming up with new ideas.", "cn": "她非常有创造力，总是能提出新的想法。"}, {"en": "What have they decided to call their new baby?", "cn": "他们决定给新宝宝起什么名字？"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. a larger or extra number or amount
2. used to form the comparative of many adjectives and adverbs
3. used to emphasize the large size of something
4. more and more
5. the more...the more/less
examples: [{"en": "• He takes more exercise now.", "cn": "• 他现在进行更多锻炼。"}, {"en": "• He takes less exercise now.", "cn": "• 他现在运动量减少了。"}, {"en": "• He smokes fewer cigarettes.", "cn": "• 他抽烟较少。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. used instead of 'a' when the following word begins with a vowel sound
2. • an easy question
3. • an interesting story
4. • an orange
examples: [{"en": "an easy question", "cn": "一个简单的问题"}, {"en": "an interesting story", "cn": "一个有趣的故事"}, {"en": "an orange", "cn": "一个橙子"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. past simple of be

[剑桥核心] 1. [GROUP] (used as the subject of a verb) the speaker and at least one other person when considered together or as a group
2. used by a speaker or a writer to refer to the listener(s) or reader and the person speaking or writing
3. [ALL PEOPLE] (used as the subject of a verb) all people, especially when considered as a group
4. [YOU] informal (used as the subject of a verb, when talking to children or ill people) you
5. [I] formal (used by a queen or king when speaking officially) I
examples: [{"en": "Can we all go to the swimming pool this afternoon?", "cn": "今天下午我们都可以去游泳池吗？"}, {"en": "If you don't hurry up we'll be late.", "cn": "如果你不快点，我们就要迟到了。"}, {"en": "Perhaps we could move on to discuss the next item on the agenda.", "cn": "也许我们可以继续讨论议程上的下一个项目。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [FUTURE] ( also 'll ) used to talk about what is going to happen in the future, especially things that you are certain about or things that are planned
2. ( also 'll ) used to talk about what someone or something is able or willing to do
3. [REQUEST] used to ask someone to do something
4. ( also 'll ) used as a polite way of inviting someone to do something, or of offering someone something
5. [IF] ( also 'll ) used in conditional sentences that start with 'if' and use the present tense
examples: [{"en": "Clare will be five years old next month.", "cn": "克莱尔下个月就五岁了。"}, {"en": "The train leaves at 8.58, so we'll be in Scotland by lunchtime.", "cn": "火车于 8.58 出发，所以我们将在午餐时间到达苏格兰。"}, {"en": "I'll see him tomorrow./I'll be seeing him tomorrow.", "cn": "明天我会见到他。/明天我会见到他。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. countable or uncountable the house, apartment, etc. where you live, especially with your family
2. countable a house, apartment, etc. when it is considered as property which you can buy or sell
3. countable the type of family you come from
4. countable a place where people or animals live and are cared for by people who are not their relations or owners
5. [ORIGIN] countable or uncountable someone's or something's place of origin, or the place where a person feels they belong
examples: [{"en": "The senator has two homes - an apartment in Washington and a house in Colorado.", "cn": "这位参议员有两处住所——一套在华盛顿的公寓和一套在科罗拉多州的房子。"}, {"en": "He was living on the streets for three months, and his home was a cardboard box.", "cn": "他在街头流浪了三个月，家里就是一个纸箱。"}, {"en": "Phone me at home after four o'clock.", "cn": "四点以后给我家里打电话。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [CONTAINER] countable ( UK also tin ) a closed metal container, especially a cylindrical one, in which some types of drink and food are sold
2. countable ( UK also tin ) the amount of food or drink that is contained in a can
3. countable a metal container, especially one with a lid, handle and shaped opening for pouring
4. [PRISON] the can
5. [TOILET] the can
examples: [{"en": "a can of soup/beans", "cn": "一罐汤/豆子"}, {"en": "You'll need a can of tuna for this recipe.", "cn": "这个食谱你需要一罐金枪鱼。"}, {"en": "an oil can", "cn": "一个油罐"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. [GROUP] (used as the object of a verb or a preposition) me and at least one other person\n2. [ME] UK not standard (especially used in spoken English) me
examples: [{"en": "Thank you for driving us to the station.", "cn": "谢谢你开车送我们到车站。"}, {"en": "Many of us in the editorial department disagree with the changes that are happening.", "cn": "我们编辑部的许多人都不同意正在发生的变化。"}, {"en": "If you get to the restaurant before us just wait at the bar.", "cn": "如果您先于我们到达餐厅，只需在酒吧等候即可。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [CONNECTED WITH] on the subject of; connected with
2. [NO ORDER] ( US around ) positioned around a place, often without a clear purpose or order
3. [POSITION] UK slightly formal in a particular place
1. [APPROXIMATELY] a little more or less than the stated number or amount; approximately
2. [ALL DIRECTIONS] ( US around ) in many different directions
examples: [{"en": "What's that book about?", "cn": "那本书是关于什么的？"}, {"en": "a film about the Spanish Civil War", "cn": "一部关于西班牙内战的电影"}, {"en": "We were talking/laughing about Sophie.", "cn": "我们正在谈论/大笑苏菲。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [IN THAT SITUATION] used to say that a particular thing can or will happen only after something else happens or becomes true
2. although
3. every time
4. used to mean 'if it is true that'
5. [WHETHER] (used to introduce a clause, often in indirect discourse , indirect speech ) whether
examples: [{"en": "I'll pay you double if you get the work finished by Friday.", "cn": "如果你在星期五之前完成工作，我将付双倍工资给你。"}, {"en": "We'll have the party in the garden if the weather's good. If not", "cn": "如果天气好的话我们会在花园里举办聚会。如果没有"}, {"en": ", it'll have to be inside.", "cn": "，它必须在里面。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [PAPER] ( written abbreviation p ) a side of one of the pieces of paper in a book, newspaper or magazine, usually with a number printed on it
2. ( written abbreviation p ) one of the sheets of paper in a book, newspaper or magazine
3. [COMPUTER] ( also web page ) one part of a website
4. [BOY] (in the past) a boy who worked as a servant for a knight and who was learning to become a knight
1. to call a person using a loudspeaker (= an electric device for making sounds louder) in a public place
examples: [{"en": "For details on how to enter the competition, see page 134.", "cn": "有关如何参加比赛的详细信息，请参阅第134页。"}, {"en": "The article appeared on the front page of the Guardian.", "cn": "这篇文章出现在《卫报》的头版。"}, {"en": "Several pages have been torn out of this book.", "cn": "这本书有好几页被撕掉了。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. of or belonging to me (= the speaker or writer)
2. my own
3. used in front of a noun as a way of expressing love or as a polite or humorous form of address
4. relating to a part of some websites where you can choose to see only the information that is important to you
examples: [{"en": "my parents", "cn": "我的父母"}, {"en": "my feet", "cn": "我的脚"}, {"en": "my name", "cn": "我的名字"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. he/she/it form of be having a twins , 've/'s , have the good sense to do something , have to do something , be having a baby , have the decency sense to do something , have , having a baby , having a twins , have got to do something , have got

[剑桥核心] 1. intransitive or transitive to look somewhere carefully in order to find something
2. intransitive to try to find the answer to a problem
3. transitive A police officer who searches you or your possessions looks for something you might be hiding
1. countable when you try to find someone or something
2. only singular when you try to find an answer to a problem
examples: [{"en": "The police searched the woods for the missing boy.", "cn": "警察在树林里搜寻失踪的男孩。"}, {"en": "She searched his face for some sign of forgiveness, but it remained expressionless.", "cn": "她在他的脸上寻找着宽恕的迹象，但他仍然面无表情。"}, {"en": "He searched (in/through) his pockets for some change.", "cn": "他在口袋里翻找零钱。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [NOT LIMITED] not limited or controlled
2. free and easy
3. [NO CHARGE] costing nothing; not needing to be paid for
4. [NOT IN PRISON] not a prisoner any longer, or having unlimited movement
5. [LOOSE] not in a fixed position or not joined to anything
examples: [{"en": "Am I free", "cn": "我有空吗"}, {"en": "to leave now?", "cn": "现在离开吗？"}, {"en": "I'll give you a key then you're free to come and go as you please.", "cn": "我会给你一把钥匙，然后你就可以随意进出。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. [FOR EMPHASIS] used to give force to a statement\n2. [ONLY] formal only; just
examples: [{"en": "She's very hard-working but not very imaginative.", "cn": "她非常勤奋，但缺乏想象力。"}, {"en": "This is not caused by evil, but by simple ignorance.", "cn": "这不是邪恶造成的，而是简单的无知造成的。"}, {"en": "The play's good, but not that good - I've seen better.", "cn": "这部剧不错，但还没有那么好——我见过更好的。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. of or belonging to us
2. • We bought our house several years ago
3. • He walked off and left us on our own

examples: [{"en": "We bought our house several years ago.", "cn": "我们几年前买了房子。"}, {"en": "He walked off and left us on our own.", "cn": "他走开了，留下我们独自一人。"}, {"en": "Drugs are one of the greatest threats in our society.", "cn": "毒品是我们社会最大的威胁之一。"}]

2. countable the things that can be seen behind the main things or people in a picture
3. [SITUATION] only singular or uncountable the conditions that existed before a particular event happened, and which help to explain why it happened
4. the background
5. [EXPERIENCE] countable your family and your experience of education, living conditions, money, etc
examples: [{"en": "The little figure that you can just see in the background of the photograph is me.", "cn": "你在照片背景中看到的那个小人物就是我。"}, {"en": "If you listen carefully to this piece of music, you can hear a flute in the background.", "cn": "如果你仔细听这首音乐，你会听到背景中有笛子的声音。"}, {"en": "We couldn't hear what they were saying on the tape - there was too much background noise .", "cn": "我们听不到他们在磁带上说的话——背景噪音太大了。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [OBJECT SHOT AT] countable an object shot at during shooting practice, often a circle with a pattern of rings, or any object or place at which bullets, bombs, etc. are aimed
2. countable usually singular a person or a particular group of people who something is directed at, or who something is intended for
3. countable usually singular one or more people who are criticized or laughed at, or who experience unpleasant treatment from others
4. [AIM] countable a level or situation which you intend to achieve
1. [DIRECT] to direct advertising, criticism or a product at someone
examples: [{"en": "I had four shots but I didn't even hit the target.", "cn": "我开了四枪，但都没击中目标。"}, {"en": "Any major airport or station is potentially a terrorist target.", "cn": "任何主要机场或车站都可能成为恐怖分子的目标。"}, {"en": "• The army fired missiles at military targets.", "cn": "• 军队向军事目标发射导弹。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. not including; but not
2. • The museum is open daily except Monday(s)
3. • The government has few options except to keep interest rates high
4. • It's cool and quiet everywhere except in the kitchen
examples: [{"en": "The museum is open daily except Monday(s).", "cn": "博物馆除周一外每天开放。"}, {"en": "The government has few options except to keep interest rates high.", "cn": "除了保持高利率之外，政府别无选择。"}, {"en": "It's cool and quiet everywhere except in the kitchen.", "cn": "除了厨房以外，到处都很凉爽、安静。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [QUALITY] countable or uncountable the particular combination of qualities in a person or place that makes them different from others
2. uncountable qualities which are interesting and unusual
3. uncountable the quality of being determined and able to deal with difficult situations
4. [IN A STORY] countable a person represented in a film, play or story
5. [PERSON] countable a person, especially when you are describing a particular quality that they have
examples: [{"en": "Politeness is traditionally part of the British character.", "cn": "礼貌是英国传统性格的一部分。"}, {"en": "It would be very out of character", "cn": "这会很不符合性格"}, {"en": "of her to lie.", "cn": "她说谎。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. Universal Serial Bus: a part of a computer to which extra devices such as printers, scanners and digital cameras can be connected easily without restarting the system\n2. • a USB port
examples: [{"en": "a USB port", "cn": "一个USB端口"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. [WORK] the work needed to keep a road, building, machine, etc. in good condition\n2. [MONEY] money that a person must pay regularly by law in order to support their child or previous marriage partner after a divorce (= official end to a marriage)\n3. [CONTINUE TO HAVE] when something continues to exist or is not allowed to become less
examples: [{"en": "Old houses need a lot of maintenance.", "cn": "老房子需要大量的维护。"}, {"en": "There are thorough maintenance checks on each plane before take-off.", "cn": "每架飞机在起飞前都会进行彻底的维护检查。"}, {"en": "The magazine offers tips on cutting your house maintenance costs.", "cn": "该杂志提供了降低房屋维护成本的建议。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. the physical or mental power or skill needed to do something
2. • There's no doubting her ability
3. • + to infinitive She had the ability to explain things clearly and concisely

examples: [{"en": "There's no doubting her ability.", "cn": "她的能力是毋庸置疑的。"}, {"en": "She had the ability to explain things clearly and concisely.", "cn": "她有能力清晰简洁地解释事情。"}, {"en": "She's a woman of considerable abilities.", "cn": "她是一个很有能力的女人。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. used to show that something is possible or that something might be true
2. informal used to show that a number or amount is approximate
3. used to politely suggest or ask for something
4. used to avoid giving a clear or certain answer to a question
5. used to mean that something is a possible explanation why something else happened
examples: [{"en": "Maybe they'll come tomorrow.", "cn": "也许他们明天会来。"}, {"en": "Maybe you were right after all.", "cn": "也许你终究是对的。"}, {"en": "There were 200, maybe 300, refugees on the boat.", "cn": "船上有200，也许300名难民。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [PURPOSE] countable the natural purpose (of something) or the duty (of a person)
2. [CEREMONY] countable an official ceremony or a formal social event, such as a party or a special meal, at which a lot of people are usually present
3. [WORK] uncountable the way in which something works or operates
4. [RESULT] a function of sth formal
5. [VALUE] countable specialized (in mathematics) a value which depends on and varies with another value
examples: [{"en": "The function of the veins is to carry blood to the heart.", "cn": "静脉的功能是将血液输送到心脏。"}, {"en": "I'm not quite sure what my function is within the company.", "cn": "我不太清楚我在公司的职责是什么。"}, {"en": "A thermostat performs the function of controlling temperature.", "cn": "恒温器执行控制温度的功能。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. [CHANGING POSITION] before noun A moving object is one that moves\n2. [FEELINGS] causing strong feelings of sadness or sympathy\n3. [CAUSING ACTION] before noun causing someone to take action
examples: [{"en": "a moving target", "cn": "移动目标"}, {"en": "moving parts in a machine", "cn": "机器中的运动部件"}, {"en": "a very moving story", "cn": "一个非常感人的故事"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [PRODUCT] a type of product made by a particular company
2. brand of sth
3. [FLAME] literary a piece of burning wood used to give light
4. [MARK] a mark that is burnt or frozen into the skin of an animal such as a cow to show who owns it
1. [JUDGE] transitive + object + noun or adjective to say that you think someone is as stated
examples: [{"en": "This isn't my usual brand of deodorant.", "cn": "这不是我常用的除臭剂品牌。"}, {"en": "When I go to a supermarket I usually buy own (", "cn": "当我去超市时我通常会自己买（"}, {"en": "store /", "cn": "商店/"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [AREA] countable an area, town, building, etc
2. countable informal someone's home
3. only singular a suitable area, building, situation or occasion
4. [POSITION] countable a position in relation to other things or people
5. countable the seat you will sit in on a particular occasion, or the seat where you usually sit, in the theatre, a class, a train, etc
examples: [{"en": "Her garden was a cool pleasant place to sit.", "cn": "她的花园是一个凉爽宜人的休息场所。"}, {"en": "What was the name of that place we drove through on the way to New York?", "cn": "我们在去纽约的路上开车经过的那个地方叫什么名字？"}, {"en": "They decided to go to a pizza place.", "cn": "他们决定去一家披萨店。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. quite, but not extremely\n2. pretty much/well
examples: [{"en": "The house has four bedrooms, so it's pretty big.", "cn": "房子有四间卧室，所以相当大。"}, {"en": "I'm pretty sure it was her.", "cn": "我很确定是她。"}, {"en": "I've got a pretty good idea of how to get there.", "cn": "我很清楚如何到达那里。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. [PRODUCT] a name or a symbol which is put on a product to show that it is made by a particular producer and which cannot be legally used by any other producer\n2. [TYPICAL] something very noticeable that a person typically has or does
examples: [{"en": "Velcro is a registered trademark.", "cn": "魔术贴是注册商标。"}, {"en": "He was wearing one of the brightly coloured ties that are his trademark.", "cn": "他戴着一条色彩鲜艳的领带，这是他的标志。"}, {"en": "She gave one of her trademark smiles.", "cn": "她露出了她标志性的微笑。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. used when both the subject and object of the verb are you\n2. used to give special attention to the subject of the sentence\n3. [PEOPLE GENERALLY] used when both the subject and object of the verb are you and you is also being used to refer to people generally
examples: [{"en": "Be careful with that knife or you'll cut yourself!", "cn": "小心那把刀，否则你会割伤自己的！"}, {"en": "Did you make the dress yourself?", "cn": "这件衣服是你自己做的吗？"}, {"en": "You can do that yourself.", "cn": "你可以自己做。"}]

definition:

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. the season between autumn and spring, lasting from November to March north of the equator and from May to September south of the equator, when the weather is coldest
2. • Last winter we went skiing
3. • It's been a surprisingly mild winter
4. • I think you tend to eat more in the winter
examples: [{"en": "Last winter we went skiing.", "cn": "去年冬天我们去滑雪。"}, {"en": "It's been a surprisingly mild winter.", "cn": "这是一个出奇的温和的冬天。"}, {"en": "I think you tend to eat more in the winter.", "cn": "我觉得冬天你会吃得更多。"}]

[PLANT] uncountable ( also oilseed rape, rapeseed ) a plant with yellow flowers from which oil and animal food are produced

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. countable a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, etc
2. [LARGE NUMBER] a battery of sth
3. [GUNS] countable a number of large guns and similar weapons operating together in the same place
4. [ATTACK] uncountable assault and battery
examples: [{"en": "a rechargeable battery", "cn": "可充电电池"}, {"en": "a battery-operated hair dryer", "cn": "电池供电的吹风机"}, {"en": "This alarm clock takes two medium-sized batteries.", "cn": "该闹钟需要两节中型电池。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. only singular or uncountable the period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young\n2. [BOY] countable disapproving a boy or a young man\n3. [YOUNG PEOPLE] uncountable + singular or plural verb young people, both male and female, considered as a group
examples: [{"en": "I was a fairly good football player in my youth.", "cn": "我年轻时是一名相当不错的足球运动员。"}, {"en": "The first volume is the author's account of his misspent youth in the bars of Dublin.", "cn": "第一卷是作者在都柏林酒吧里度过的青春时光的记述。"}, {"en": "He looks like a man who's found the secret to eternal youth", "cn": "他看起来像是一个找到了永葆青春秘密的人"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [PUSH] uncountable the force you produce when you press something
2. countable or uncountable the force that a liquid or gas produces when it presses against an area
3. [PERSUADE] when someone tries to make someone else do something by arguing, persuading, etc
4. countable or uncountable a difficult situation that makes you feel worried or unhappy
5. So no pressure then! humorous
examples: [{"en": "He put too much pressure on the door handle and it snapped.", "cn": "他对门把手施加了太大的压力，门把手突然折断了。"}, {"en": "You can stop bleeding by applying pressure close to the injured area.", "cn": "您可以通过在受伤部位附近施加压力来止血。"}, {"en": "gas/water pressure", "cn": "燃气/水压"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. [GIVE] transitive to give or offer something for a decision to be made by others\n2. transitive + that formal to suggest\n3. [ALLOW] intransitive or transitive to allow another person or group to have power or authority over you, or to accept something unwillingly
examples: [{"en": "You must submit your application before January 1st.", "cn": "您必须在 1 月 1 日之前提交申请。"}, {"en": "The developers submitted building plans to the council for approval.", "cn": "开发商向理事会提交了建筑计划以供批准。"}, {"en": "In conclusion, I submit that the proposal will not work without some major changes.", "cn": "总之，我认为如果不进行一些重大改变，该提案将无法发挥作用。"}]

definition:

[剑桥核心] 1. [MIDDLE] being in the middle between an upper and lower amount, size, degree or value

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. a device shaped like a box with a screen which receives electrical signals and changes them into moving images and sound, or the method or business of sending images and sound by electrical signals
2. • a colour/black-and-white television
3. • Could you turn the television down?
4. • It's one of the few television programmes that I always make a point of watching
examples: [{"en": "a colour/black-and-white television", "cn": "彩色/黑白电视"}, {"en": "Could you turn the television down?", "cn": "你能把电视关小一点吗？"}, {"en": "It's one of the few television programmes that I always make a point of watching.", "cn": "这是我总是重点观看的少数电视节目之一。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. [INVOLVED] wanting to give your attention to something and discover more about it\n2. [LEGAL RIGHT] relating to a person or group who have a connection with a particular situation, event, business, etc
examples: [{"en": "He didn't seem very interested in what I was saying.", "cn": "他似乎对我说的话不太感兴趣。"}, {"en": "She's at that age where she's starting to get interested in boys.", "cn": "她已经到了开始对男孩感兴趣的年龄。"}, {"en": "I'd be interested to hear more about your work.", "cn": "我很有兴趣了解更多有关您工作的信息。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [IMPORTANT PART] only singular or uncountable the basic and most important part of something

examples: [{"en": "The basic lack of government funding is at the core of the problem.", "cn": "政府资金的基本缺乏是问题的核心。"}, {"en": "The final status negotiations would focus on the core issues of the peace process.", "cn": "最终地位谈判将集中讨论和平进程的核心问题。"}, {"en": "The company's core operations include entertainment and aviation.", "cn": "该公司的核心业务包括娱乐和航空。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [DAMAGE] intransitive or transitive to (cause something to) separate suddenly or violently into two or more pieces, or to (cause something to) stop working by being damaged

3. break a/the record
4. [NOT OBEY] transitive to fail to keep a law, rule or promise

definition:

definition:

2. countable a door, gate, etc. by which you enter a place
3. [INFORMATION] countable a separate piece of information that is recorded in a book, computer, etc
4. [COMPETITION] countable or uncountable a piece of work that you do in order to take part in a competition, or the act of taking part in a competition
examples: [{"en": "A flock of sheep blocked our entry to the village.", "cn": "一群羊挡住了我们进村的路。"}, {"en": "I can't go down that street - there's a 'No entry' sign.", "cn": "我不能沿着那条街走——那里有一个“禁止入内”的标志。"}, {"en": "The actress's entry into the world of politics surprised most people.", "cn": "这位女演员进入政界令大多数人感到惊讶。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [DAY] a numbered day in a month, often given with a combination of the name of the day, the month and the year
2. a particular year
3. a month and a year
4. [MEETING] a social meeting planned before it happens, especially one between two people who have or might have a romantic relationship
5. US a person you have a romantic meeting with
examples: [{"en": "What's the date (today)?/What date is it?/What's today's date?", "cn": "今天是几号？/今天是几号？/今天是几号？"}, {"en": "Today's date is (Friday) the 24th of June/June the 24th (1994).", "cn": "今天的日期是 6 月 24 日（星期五）/6 月 24 日（1994 年）。"}, {"en": "What is your date of birth ?", "cn": "您的出生日期是哪一天？"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. [CREATE] to cause something to exist\n2. [MAKE ENERGY] to produce energy in a particular form
examples: [{"en": "Her latest film has generated a lot of interest/excitement .", "cn": "她的最新电影引起了很大的兴趣/兴奋。"}, {"en": "The new development will generate 1500 new jobs.", "cn": "新开发项目将创造1500个新就业岗位。"}, {"en": "These measures will increase the club's ability to generate revenue/income .", "cn": "这些措施将提高俱乐部创收的能力。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [WRITE] intransitive or transitive to write your name, usually on a written or printed document, to show that you agree with its contents or have written or created it yourself
2. transitive in sport, to make a legal written agreement to employ a player
3. [BODY MOVEMENT] intransitive or transitive to give an order or information, or make a request, using hand and body movements
4. intransitive or transitive to use sign language (= language used by people who cannot hear or talk)

examples: [{"en": "to sign a letter/cheque/contract/lease/agreement", "cn": "签署信函/支票/合同/租约/协议"}, {"en": "Sign here, please.", "cn": "请在这里签名。"}, {"en": "He signed his name at the end of the letter.", "cn": "他在信的最后签上了自己的名字。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. [HIGHER] the top part of a shoe which covers a person's foot and to which the heel and the sole are fixed\n2. [DRUG] informal a drug which causes a person taking it to feel very active and excited
examples: [{"en": "The office block's upper floors were being repainted.", "cn": "办公楼的上层正在重新粉刷。"}, {"en": "If the infection is not checked it will probably spread to the upper body.", "cn": "如果不检查感染，它可能会扩散到上半身。"}, {"en": "We sat in one of the upper tiers of the football stands.", "cn": "我们坐在足球看台的上层之一。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. relating to the arrangements and work which is needed to control the operation of a plan or organization

3. • an administrative problem
4. • Your responsibilities will be mainly administrative
examples: [{"en": "administrative work", "cn": "行政工作"}, {"en": "an administrative problem", "cn": "行政问题"}, {"en": "Your responsibilities will be mainly administrative.", "cn": "您的职责主要是行政方面的。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [BAD] severe in effect; bad
2. [NOT JOKING] not joking or intended to be funny
3. A serious person is quiet, thinks carefully about things and does not laugh a lot

examples: [{"en": "a serious illness", "cn": "一场严重的疾病"}, {"en": "There were no reports of serious injuries.", "cn": "目前还没有严重受伤的报告。"}, {"en": "The new tax regulations have landed some of the smaller companies in serious trouble.", "cn": "新的税收法规使一些规模较小的公司陷入了严重的麻烦。"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. main or most important
2. of the best quality
1. to tell someone something that will prepare them for a particular situation

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. countable the greatest amount, number or level of something that is either possible or allowed

examples: [{"en": "Is there a limit on the amount of money you can claim?", "cn": "您可以索赔的金额有限制吗？"}, {"en": "I think we ought to put a strict limit on the amount of time we can spend on the project.", "cn": "我认为我们应该严格限制花在该项目上的时间。"}, {"en": "There's a limit to the number of times I can stop what I'm doing just so I can help him!", "cn": "我停下手头的事情来帮助他的次数是有限的！"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [PLACE TO BUY THINGS] ( US usually store ) a building, or a room in a building, where you can buy goods or get services

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. [SERVANT] literary the state of being another person's slave (= a person who is owned by them and has to work for them)\n2. [SEX] the activity of tying parts of a person's body so that they cannot move in order to get or give sexual pleasure

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. countable or uncountable physical or mental activity needed to achieve something\n2. countable the result of an attempt to produce something, especially when its quality is low or uncertain

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. having a lot of knowledge or information about something
2. • an informed choice/opinion
3. • The school promised to keep parents informed about the situation
4. • Elizabeth is remarkably well -informed
examples: [{"en": "an informed choice/opinion", "cn": "知情的选择/意见"}, {"en": "The school promised to keep parents informed about the situation.", "cn": "学校承诺将向家长通报相关情况。"}, {"en": "Elizabeth is remarkably well -informed.", "cn": "伊丽莎白消息灵通。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. [ELECTRICITY] uncountable abbreviation for alternating current: electrical current which regularly changes the direction in which it flows\n2. [AIR] countable or uncountable US abbreviation for air conditioner or air conditioning

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. UK a narrow area of water that flows into the land from the sea, a lake, etc\n2. US a stream or narrow river

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [ACTIVITY] uncountable an activity, such as a job, which a person uses physical or mental effort to do, usually for money
2. uncountable the material used by someone at work, or what they produce
3. [PLACE] uncountable a place where a person goes specially to do their job
4. [CREATION] countable something created as a result of effort, especially a painting, book or piece of music
5. [EVERYTHING] the works informal
examples: [{"en": "I've got so much work to do .", "cn": "我还有很多工作要做。"}, {"en": "Carrying heavy loads around all day is hard work.", "cn": "整天搬运重物是一项艰苦的工作。"}, {"en": "What time do you start/finish work?", "cn": "你什么时间开始/结束工作？"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. the amount or number of something, especially that can be measured or is fixed
2. • Police found a large/small quantity of drugs in his possession

examples: [{"en": "Police found a large/small quantity of drugs in his possession.", "cn": "警方在他身上发现了大量/少量的毒品。"}, {"en": "We consumed vast quantities of food and drink that night.", "cn": "那天晚上我们消耗了大量的食物和饮料。"}, {"en": "The ( sheer ) quantity", "cn": "（绝对）数量"}]

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. of or in a city or town
2. • urban development
3. • urban decay

definition:
[剑桥核心] 1. [ACTION] uncountable action rather than thought or ideas
2. [REGULAR ACTIVITY] countable or uncountable something that is usually or regularly done, often as a habit, tradition or custom
3. make a practice of sth UK old-fashioned
4. [TRAINING] countable or uncountable when you do something regularly or repeatedly to improve your skill at doing it
5. [WORK] countable a job or business which involves a lot of skill or training
examples: [{"en": "It seemed like a good idea before we started, but in practice it was a disaster.", "cn": "在我们开始之前，这似乎是一个好主意，但实际上这是一场灾难。"}, {"en": "Officially, Robert's in charge, but in practice Hannah runs the office.", "cn": "名义上是罗伯特负责，但实际上是汉娜负责管理办公室。"}, {"en": "I can't see how your plan is going to work in practice.", "cn": "我看不出你的计划在实践中如何运作。"}]

definition: [剑桥核心] 1. when something is correctly organized or repaired, or when someone has the things they need\n2. • Debbie's sorted for Tuesday night because she's found a babysitter\n3. • "Have you spoken to Grant about the party?" "Sorted!"
examples: [{"en": "Debbie's sorted for Tuesday night because she's found a babysitter.", "cn": "黛比安排了周二晚上，因为她找到了保姆。"}, {"en": "\"Have you spoken to Grant about the party?\" \"Sorted!\"", "cn": "“你和格兰特谈过聚会的事了吗？” “已排序！”"}]

definition:

examples: [{"en": "We rang the insurance company to report the theft.", "cn": "我们打电话给保险公司报告盗窃案。"}, {"en": "The assassination was reported in all the newspapers.", "cn": "所有报纸都报道了这起暗杀事件。"}, {"en": "I want you to report ( to me) on progress", "cn": "我希望你（向我）报告进展情况"}]

definition:

definition:

definition:
